attrs.discharge: A static walk cannot establish this about itself: the walk is exactly what a computed specifier is invisible to. Discharging it needs either a lint refusing computed dynamic imports in the bound set, or a runtime module-load trace compared against the static closure. Neither exists here.
attrs.note: No witness in this tree uses one — measured by reading them, not by a checker. DEF-REPRO-DYNAMIC-IMPORT has carried the same doubt against REPRO-CLOSURE since INV-R5.1; this is the second claim to rest on it, and naming it is what makes RECEIPT-BINDS-IMPORT-CLOSURE CONDITIONAL here instead of PROVED as it was on the source lane.
attrs.statement: No executable a transition receipt names reaches a module through a dynamic `import()` with a computed specifier.
